topic: Identify whether 2023 second-qualifier, final practice, and national-final ZIP bundles contain only judge data; do not treat them as task PDFs or solutions without content review.
2023 girls-division final ZIP is explicitly judge input-output data; keep review until metadata can establish its precise role without downloading archive.
Parent JOI/JOIG 2022/23 pages state CC BY-SA 4.0 for contest problem materials; verify whether the notice covers sample code, scoring data and English translations separately.
Track Japanese/English versions and combined problem booklets as separate URLs but potential same logical tasks; avoid counting each translation as distinct problem.
JOI 2021/22 first-qualifier archive links a JOI 2020/21 guideline page; preserve target year 2021 and parent year 2022 without conflation.
Hungarian KöMaL October 2019 links labelled megoldás, statisztika lead to one problem page with solution and statistics; avoid claiming each URL is solution-only.
KöMaL M389 anchor is only statisztika, without explicit solution; leave review and determine whether same destination has a problem or solution.
Concurs Φ historical archive lists editions 2003–2025; verify which years have accessible statements, official solutions, grading criteria and multiple dates in 2008.
AGH O Diamentowy Indeks historical stage archives show page/2 and 'Poprzednie'; follow additional pages and audit all editions beyond 2007/08–2016/17.
AGH stage 1–3 physics, chemistry and mathematics HTML indexes confirm task links; official solutions and scoring criteria not established for every stage/year.
Hungarian Oláh György chemistry archive shows some finals with 'megoldás feltöltés alatt' (solution pending); do not mark final-round solutions complete.

Official 2025 school-stage keys for music and art are visible; check district and national stages, prior editions and separate grading rubrics.
Regional Ukrainian multisubject bank mixes Google Drive and SharePoint links with unlinked subject labels; audit actual public availability and stage-year coverage without access bypass.
Kyiv economics category includes stage III tasks/answers for some years; check national stage IV and years with only results, not problem materials.
phoXiv HTML listing is JS-driven and visible page does not enumerate cards; confirm public API/navigation metadata and provenance before assuming complete coverage.
Jessup Compendium describes problems, bench memos and participant memorials but indicates purchase/subscription; do not attempt access bypass or treat paid materials as open.
Econ Wars search-index result advertises archived economics papers but live HTML extraction returned no text; keep unverified and check JS/robots accessibility only.
UCI moot-court archive is search-index-visible but direct HTML request returned 403; do not bypass and do not claim problem accessibility.
